acces.title: Access & Tourism
acces.seo_title: Access and Tourism - Hôtel Arc en Ciel Eze
acces.seo_description: How to get to Hôtel Arc en Ciel in Eze Village. Discover nearby beaches and attractions.
acces.intro: Ideally located on the middle corniche between Nice (8 km) and Monaco (6 km), Eze Village is a magical place planted in the azure, preserving an authentic atmosphere.

access_modes.desc: A8 highway exit 57 (La Turbie), take the direction of Eze Village. Parking near the tourist office.
Nice Côte d'Azur international airport (25 km). Transfer by taxi or bus possible.
Regional buses from Nice airport. Stop at 50m from the hotel.
Nearest train stations: Nice (8 km) or Monaco (7 km). Eze station at 2.2 km.
